title: Line sketch: Cosmic Teardrop Orbit
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A large central biomorphic shape resembling a droplet or whale dominates the frame, encircled by concentric rings, scattered dots, and flowing curved bands. Smaller circles of varying sizes create rhythmic orbits around the main form against a dark background, suggesting depth and motion. Bold flat color fields with crisp edges define the graphic, layered composition (derived from painting #107).
